context.note: Google Analytics is already added in the app. This spec adds GTM + a clean dataLayer event model + Consent Mode v2 gating.

principles: Default to no non-essential cookies until user consent is obtained (PECR/UK GDPR expectation for analytics/marketing cookies).
Provide Accept and Reject with equal prominence; rejection must be as easy as acceptance.
Do not send PII (email, username, userId) to Google tags/events; use non-identifying ids if needed (session_id, game_id uuid is OK if not linkable to a natural person).
Honor consent changes: allow user to change preferences later (settings page).
Document purposes, vendors, retention in cookie policy + privacy policy.

references: Google Consent Mode: default denied unless configured; update after banner interaction.
Google Tag Platform consent guide explains behavior when denied.

sources.ico_cookies_guidance: Use ICO guidance for cookies and consent standards.
sources.google_consent_mode: Use Google consent mode docs for default + update flow.

options: Use your existing CMP if present; it must be able to emit consent state changes
If no CMP: add a lightweight CMP that supports Consent Mode v2 signals
phase_0_decisions.requirement: CMP must expose an onConsentChanged callback and allow accept/reject with equal ease.

options: Preferred: move GA4 tag into GTM and remove direct gtag snippet (cleanest governance).
Alternative: keep existing GA snippet but ensure Consent Mode v2 default+update are applied BEFORE GA loads.
phase_0_decisions.instruction: Choose one path; do not double-fire pageviews.

phase_1_add_gtm_bootstrap: Create GTM container in Google Tag Manager (Web).
Add GTM container snippet to Next.js root layout (App Router) in a consent-aware way.
Create a small client-only module to push dataLayer events: window.dataLayer.push({event, ...payload}).
Add route-change tracking for App Router navigation to emit a single 'page_view' style event per navigation.
phase_2_consent_mode_wiring: Implement Consent Mode v2 default state at the earliest possible time (Consent Initialization).
Connect CMP choice -> gtag('consent','update', ...) and a dataLayer event 'consent_update'.
Block any analytics/ads tags until consent grants relevant storage (analytics_storage / ad_storage...).
Expose a Settings UI action to reopen consent preferences and apply changes.
phase_3_event_model_and_tags: Implement event taxonomy below (recommended GA4 names where possible).
Configure GTM triggers/variables for each event.
Send events to GA4 via GTM GA4 Event tags (or to existing GA via dataLayer->gtag mapping, if keeping GA snippet).
Add basic error/exception and web vitals events (consent-gated).
phase_4_validation_and_tests: Use GTM Preview/Debug to verify firing rules with consent denied vs granted.
Verify no cookies are set pre-consent for analytics.
Add Playwright E2E tests: consent accept/reject flows + verify tags blocked/unblocked.
Add unit tests for event payload builders (no PII; required fields present).

global_rules.naming: Use snake_case keys; event names use GA4 recommended where relevant.
no_pii: Do not include: email, username, full name, IP, exact location, chat message content.
Allow: session_id (random UUID v4), game_id (uuid), track_slug, lesson_slug, time_control metadata.

event_taxonomy.when: On initial load and on client-side route change (App Router navigation).

event_taxonomy.notes: Use GA4 recommended event name. method could be 'email' or 'oauth_google' etc.

event_taxonomy.when: User clicks primary CTAs like 'Play', 'Learn', 'Leaderboard teaser' on Home.
event_taxonomy.notes: GA4 recommended event name for content selection.

event_taxonomy.when: Game room /game/[id] becomes active (first render with game state ready).
Every N moves (e.g., 10) or on game end; DO NOT send per-move events to avoid spam.
User sends a chat message in game. Do NOT include message content.
User starts a Learn lesson (/learn/lesson/[lessonSlug]) for the first time in a session.
User changes theme, sound, board prefs, or privacy settings on /settings.
Unhandled error boundary hit or critical API errors (sampled).
event_taxonomy.notes: Do not send stack traces to GA; keep it high-level. Use Sentry/etc separately if desired (also consent-gated).

event_taxonomy.when: On reporting Core Web Vitals (LCP/CLS/INP etc).

triggers.name: Consent Initialization - Default Denied
triggers.purpose: Set consent defaults before any tag fires.

tags.name: GA4 Configuration (via GTM)
tags.note: If keeping existing GA snippet, do NOT add this tag; instead use GA4 Event tags only (or remove entirely and route all GA through GTM).

mapping.event_params: Pass through all non-PII DLV keys

files_to_add.purpose: Single safe push function with schema guard + PII stripping.
Generate and persist anonymous session_id (memory + localStorage only if functional consent is granted; otherwise keep in-memory).
CMP UI (if you do not already have one). Must support Accept/Reject and later changes.

changes: Add GTM snippet (and optional noscript) in a privacy-aware manner.
Ensure Consent Mode default runs before analytics tags (either via GTM Consent Initialization or inline if not possible).
Emit dataLayer events at key moments: auth success, invite actions, matchmaking join/leave, game start/end, learn begin/complete, settings changes.

route_change_tracking.approach: Use App Router hooks (usePathname + useSearchParams) in a client component mounted in layout to emit 'page_view' once per navigation when analytics consent is granted.
route_change_tracking.dedupe: Maintain last_page_path in memory to avoid duplicate events.

acceptance_criteria: With consent rejected: GA/GTM does not set analytics cookies; analytics tags do not fire (except consent defaults).
With consent accepted: page_view and key events fire once with correct payload.
No PII is present in event payloads.
Reject is as easy as accept in the banner UI; consent can be changed later in Settings.
No double pageviews (either GA in GTM OR direct GA snippet; not both).
GTM Preview shows correct consent state transitions and tag firing behavior.

unit: datalayer push function strips disallowed keys (email/username/user_id)
move_summary bucketing logic works (every N moves)
e2e_playwright: Visit / with banner visible -> click Reject -> navigate to /play -> confirm no analytics tags fired (via network assertions where feasible).
Visit / -> Accept -> navigate /play -> start bot game -> expect game_start then game_end events.
Learn: start a lesson -> tutorial_begin; finish -> tutorial_complete.

notes_for_ai_executor.implementation_rule: Where IDs are required, read them from env vars (NEXT_PUBLIC_GTM_ID, NEXT_PUBLIC_GA_ID).
notes_for_ai_executor.privacy_rule: If uncertain whether a field is personal data, do not send it.
